entities.name: City of Brass
entities.description: Mystical stone and brass city on the edge of Rabiah, inhabited by efreets, djinns and Brass Men.

entities.name: Fatima
entities.description: Aggrieved planeswalker who legend says built the city.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Region at whose edge the city lies.

entities.name: Brass Man
entities.description: Most numerous citizen of the City of Brass.

events.summary: According to legend, the planeswalker Fatima built the City of Brass seeking solace from great pain.
events.quote: was built long ago by an aggrieved planeswalker, Fatima , who wished solace from great pain

relations.quote: was built long ago by an aggrieved planeswalker, Fatima
